SELECT 
    s."equipRef",
    c."antenna_stat",
    c."netLatency_ms",
    s."calibrStat",
    s."measureAccPct",
    l."locType",
    CASE 
        WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Valid' THEN 1.0
        WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Due' THEN 0.7
        WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Expired' THEN 0.3
        ELSE 0
    END AS calib_factor,
    CASE 
        WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Error' THEN 0
        WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Warning' THEN 5
        WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Normal' THEN 10
        ELSE 0
    END AS antenna_base,
    (1 - c."netLatency_ms" / 1000.0) AS latency_factor
FROM "Scientific" s
JOIN "Communication" c ON s."equipRef" = c."equipRef"
JOIN "Location" l ON c."loc_link" = l."STATION_name"
WHERE l."locType" = 'Arctic'
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    s."equipRef",
    c."antenna_stat",
    c."netLatency_ms",
    s."calibrStat",
    s."measureAccPct",
    l."locType",
    -- CRI calculation
    CASE 
        WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Error' THEN 0
        WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Warning' THEN 5
        WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Normal' THEN 10
        ELSE 0
    END * GREATEST(0, (1 - c."netLatency_ms" / 1000.0)) AS CRI,
    -- SER calculation  
    s."measureAccPct" * CASE 
        WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Valid' THEN 1.0
        WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Due' THEN 0.7
        WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Expired' THEN 0.3
        ELSE 0
    END AS SER,
    -- SMSP = SER * (0.8 + 0.2 * CRI / 10)
    s."measureAccPct" * CASE 
        WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Valid' THEN 1.0
        WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Due' THEN 0.7
        WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Expired' THEN 0.3
        ELSE 0
    END * (0.8 + 0.2 * (CASE 
        WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Error' THEN 0
        WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Warning' THEN 5
        WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Normal' THEN 10
        ELSE 0
    END * GREATEST(0, (1 - c."netLatency_ms" / 1000.0))) / 10.0) AS SMSP
FROM "Scientific" s
JOIN "Communication" c ON s."equipRef" = c."equipRef"
JOIN "Location" l ON c."loc_link" = l."STATION_name"
WHERE l."locType" = 'Arctic'
ORDER BY SMSP DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST(
        s."measureAccPct" * CASE 
            WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Valid' THEN 1.0
            WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Due' THEN 0.7
            WHEN s."calibrStat" = 'Expired' THEN 0.3
            ELSE 0
        END * (0.8 + 0.2 * (CASE 
            WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Error' THEN 0
            WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Warning' THEN 5
            WHEN c."antenna_stat" = 'Normal' THEN 10
            ELSE 0
        END * GREATEST(0, (1 - c."netLatency_ms" / 1000.0))) / 10.0) AS numeric), 2) AS best_case_probability
FROM "Scientific" s
JOIN "Communication" c ON s."equipRef" = c."equipRef"
JOIN "Location" l ON c."loc_link" = l."STATION_name"
WHERE l."locType" = 'Arctic'
ORDER BY SMSP DESC
LIMIT 1;
